test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

She seems to be / exhausted after talking for / a couple of hours to the public.

options.text: a couple of hours to the public

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"a couple of hours to the public."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition **"to"** is incorrect in this context and it should be** "with"** instead.
 
• **"Talking to"** can mean that one person is talking and the other is merely listening; it is one-way communication.
 
 
• **Example**: *The minister was** talking to**__ us regarding his plans.*
 
 
 
• In the case of** "talking with,"** the implication is of a conversation, a two-way communication.
 __
 
• **Example**: *The teacher is **talking with**__ us about the latest syllabus.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *She seems to be exhausted after talking for __**a couple of hours with the public**__.*
